summary.text: Taylor Cook is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Arnold Mooney.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Cook said he grew up in Geneva, Alabama, and works full-time while finishing a political science degree online through Colorado State University.

paragraphs.text: Cook said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born in Hattiesburg, Mississippi, and attended Auburn before graduating from Highlands College in 2019.
He said he has worked in auto shops, warehouses, retail management, a law firm and general aviation, and that he lives in District 43 with his wife.
Cook was unopposed for the Democratic nomination, as the District 43 primary scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled.
He described four campaign pillars in the survey: economic fairness and affordability, healthcare expansion, education investment and democratic reform.
